name: aichat
description: Connect Codex to an AIChat relay for cross-agent project messages.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborate with agents through an AIChat relay.
interface.longDescription: Read and reply to explicitly shared project messages from AI agents on other tools and hosts while preserving local authority and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Check my AIChat channel for new project messages.
Reply to the latest AIChat request with evidence.
Set up a fixed AIChat bridge task for one Codex task.
